title.zh:
异色收集，
从等待结果到规划路线。
title.en:
Shiny collection:
from waiting to planning.

kicker.zh: 《洛克王国：世界》 · S3 解析 / S5 原创提案
kicker.en: Roco Kingdom: World · S3 analysis / Original S5 proposals

summary.zh: 我先还原捕捉、奇遇与入库之间的关系，再用实测检验投入产出口径，最后提出两套机制与交互原型。重点不是宣称效果，而是让每个判断都能追到规则和证据。
summary.en: I mapped the relationship between capture, encounters and collection, examined the cost model against gameplay records, then developed two mechanics and an interactive prototype. Each decision is connected to its rules and evidence.

status.zh: 个人作品集项目 · S5 为原创设计，非官方赛季内容
status.en: Personal portfolio project · S5 content is an original, unofficial proposal

value.zh: 规则 · 数值口径 · 反馈 · 原型

title.zh: 延长收集目标，让玩家有更多追求。
title.en: Give players more to collect and pursue.

judgment.zh: 同一条玩家操作链，需要同时说清动作、状态、结果和证据。
judgment.en: One player journey needs a clear account of actions, state, outcomes and evidence.

body.zh: 延长收集目标，给玩家更多追求，增加在线活跃时长。
body.en: Extend collection goals, give players more to pursue, and encourage longer active play.

body.zh: 用实机截图、主流程与配置表说明怎么玩、如何处理。
body.en: Explain play and system responses through gameplay screenshots, a main flow and configuration tables.

body.zh: 记录投球消耗、回顾收益与牵手情景，检查下一轮资源从哪里来。
body.en: Track ball costs, review income and co-op scenarios to examine how the next run is funded.

body.zh: A优化连续捕捉，B增加生态调查，分别写清规则、流程和配置。
body.en: A refines continuous capture; B adds ecological investigation, each with rules, flows and configuration.

scope_note.zh: 这是个人系统策划作品，不属于官方开发经历；原型演示不代表正式游戏实现或上线成果。
scope_note.en: This is a personal systems design project, not official development experience. The prototype does not represent a production game or live results.

title.zh: 先出现书，再进入对应奇遇。
title.en: A book appears before its encounter begins.

judgment.zh: 成功捕捉触发童话书或绘本，完成战斗或故事后揭晓精灵，捕捉成功才入库。
judgment.en: Successful captures trigger a Storybook or Picture Book; combat or story reveals candidates, and only successful captures add them to storage.

body.zh: 成功捕捉触发童话书或绘本，完成战斗或故事后揭晓精灵，捕捉成功才入库。
body.en: Successful captures trigger a Storybook or Picture Book; combat or story reveals candidates, and only successful captures add them to storage.

body.zh: 选目标、区域与球种。每次投球计入成本，失败不增加成功捕捉连锁。
body.en: Choose the goal, area and ball. Every throw counts as cost; a failed capture adds no successful-capture progress.

body.zh: 童话球等必中球按最高捕捉难度累计；其他球按目标实际难度累计。换算系数未公开。
body.en: Guaranteed-capture balls, including the seasonal ball, use maximum capture difficulty; other balls use the target’s actual difficulty. Conversion coefficients are not public.

body.zh: 奇遇触发时先决定童话书或绘本；触碰童话书后才出现四叶草铅绘。
body.en: The trigger selects a Storybook or Picture Book; clover art appears only after touching a Storybook.

body.zh: 童话书经历战斗、破盾与着色；绘本完成五幕故事后生成候选，玩家再进行捕捉。
body.en: The Storybook uses combat, shield breaking and coloring. The Picture Book reveals candidates after five story acts, followed by capture.

body.zh: 分开查看捕获、事件来源、耗球和收入，再决定继续、换目标或结束。
body.en: Review captures, event sources, balls spent and income before continuing, changing goals or stopping.

body.zh: 出现童话书 → 触碰出铅绘 → 战斗破盾着色 → 揭晓精灵 → 捕捉入库；童话书异色必带特长。
body.en: Storybook appears → touch to create clover art → battle, break shield and color → reveal → capture to collect; Storybook shinies always have a specialty.

body.zh: 绘本入口 → 五幕故事 → 10个候选且至少1个异色 → 自由捕捉；未关闭且未到期可重入，最长保留4小时。
body.en: Picture Book entrance → five acts → ten candidates with at least one shiny → free capture; re-enter before closure or expiry, up to four hours.

title.zh: 野生污染 · 并行事件

body.zh: 单独记录污染、血脉与最终结果，不把它写成草团子或童话书的子结果。
body.en: Record corruption, lineage and final outcomes separately; this is not a child branch of clover or Storybook events.

visible_limit.zh: 30个未处理书本／铅绘只触发数量提示，不是硬容量或异色保障；表内未公开参数为复现示例，S5数值是原创设计。
visible_limit.en: Thirty pending books or clover objects trigger a warning, not a hard cap or shiny guarantee. Unpublished S3 parameters are reconstruction examples; S5 values are original design choices.

image_caption.zh: 作者实机截图与箭头流程；可放大核对对应操作。
image_caption.en: The author’s gameplay screenshots and annotated flow. Enlarge to inspect each operation.

title.zh: 资源能继续循环，惊喜也要保留。
title.en: Keep the resource loop going—and the surprise.

judgment.zh: 10批实测账面收入／球成本约59.4%，牵手折算情景约118.8%；后者不是单人对照，也不是固定双倍奖励。
judgment.en: Across ten batches, recorded income covers about 59.4% of ball cost; the co-op multiplier scenario reaches 118.8%, not a solo control or a fixed double-reward rule.

body.zh: 日常资源和回顾收益用于补球；实测关注下一轮能否继续，不把每轮回本设为设计目的。
body.en: Daily resources and exploration income fund more balls; the records examine repeat play, not guaranteed cost recovery on every run.

metric_caption.zh: 样本规模，不是官方概率、上线成绩或玩家代表性样本。来源：最终《15 刷取数据》汇总。
metric_caption.en: Sample scope—not official odds, live results or a representative player sample. Source: final farming-data summary.

visible_limit.zh: 异色记录未逐条分清普通奇遇、绘本与野外来源，也缺少对应奇遇完成数，不能用“异色数 ÷ 草团子数”计算普通奇遇基础率。
visible_limit.en: Shiny records do not consistently distinguish regular encounters, Picture Books and field sources, and completed-encounter counts are missing. Shiny count ÷ clovers cannot estimate the regular-encounter base rate.

body.zh: 日常资源与探索回顾补充洛克贝，再购买下一轮需要的球。
body.en: Daily play and exploration reviews provide currency for the next set of balls.

body.zh: 心仪异色比不喜欢的异色更有价值，消耗可接受与否取决于收集目标。
body.en: A desired shiny can be worth more to the player than an unwanted one; acceptable cost depends on their collection goal.

body.zh: 增加玩家联系与共同回收机会；每人的投球、候选与收益分开记录。
body.en: Create social ties and shared opportunities while tracking each player’s throws, candidates and income separately.

title.zh: 保留熟悉循环，还是增加主动选择？
title.en: Refine the familiar loop, or add more agency?

judgment.zh: 推荐B增加调查玩法；制作周期不足时采用A，保留熟悉的捕捉循环。
judgment.en: Recommend B for investigation play; choose A when the schedule calls for the familiar capture loop.

body.zh: 两案都围绕固定收集目标，清楚展示进度、结果与保障。
body.en: Both proposals use fixed collection goals with visible progress, outcomes and guarantees.

design_badge.zh: 以下均为 S5 原创设计初稿，非官方概率与规则
design_badge.en: All values below are original S5 draft parameters—not official rates or rules

role.zh: 制作周期受限时的备选
role.en: Fallback for a shorter production schedule

concept.zh: 捕捉攒音符，完成演奏后揭晓精灵。
concept.en: Build notes through capture, then perform to reveal a creature.

loop.zh: 选目标 → 有效捕捉 → 28 音符成章 → 演奏与破罩 → 揭晓 → 捕捉
loop.en: Choose target → eligible captures → 28 notes → perform & break shield → reveal → capture

rules.zh: 匹配目标来源的捕捉才给1／2／4音符，赛季球及必中球给4。
rules.en: Eligible captures give 1/2/4 notes; seasonal and guaranteed balls give 4.

rules.zh: 每满28音符生成乐章并保留余数；30条未开奖时暂停积累。
rules.en: Every 28 notes creates a movement, keeping the remainder; 30 pending movements pause accumulation.

rules.zh: 主目标／关联／特邀按70／20／10选取，基础任意异色率5%。
rules.en: Select target / related / guest at 70/20/10; the base any-shiny rate is 5%.

rules.zh: 第61次起每次增加0.5个百分点，第80次直接生成目标异色。
rules.en: From attempt 61, add 0.5 percentage points per attempt; attempt 80 generates the target shiny.

rules.zh: 普通乐章生成目标异色才重置保障，换目标不转移进度。
rules.en: Only a regular target-shiny generation resets its guarantee; target progress never transfers.

rules.zh: 另有1%额外协奏：8候选至少1异色，不替换普通结果或改变普通保障。
rules.en: A separate 1% bonus concert has eight candidates and at least one shiny, without replacing the regular result or changing its guarantee.

strength.zh: 复用成熟循环，学习成本与制作改动较低。
strength.en: Reuses the familiar loop, with lower learning and production costs.

tradeoff.zh: 连续捕捉仍占主体，重复操作改善有限。
tradeoff.en: Continuous capture remains central, so the reduction in repetition is limited.

concept.zh: 收集线索，完成调查后选择奖励方向。
concept.en: Gather clues, finish an investigation, then choose the reward focus.

loop.zh: 选目标 → 收集两类线索 → 组合定位 → 三项调查 → 选奖励路线 → 揭晓与捕捉
loop.en: Choose target → gather two clue types → locate zone → complete three tasks → choose reward focus → reveal & capture

rules.zh: 足迹、叫声、残留、环境共四类，两类各120点定位一轮。
rules.en: Four clue types—tracks, calls, traces and habitat—form six pairs; spend 120 of each selected type.

rules.zh: 捕捉给1／2／4点，拍照或观察给10点，每类非捕捉最多60点。
rules.en: Captures give 1/2/4 points; photos or observations give 10, capped at 60 non-capture points per type.

rules.zh: 首次入区起12分钟，完成三项任务共100分后停表，离线不暂停。
rules.en: The 12-minute clock starts on first entry and stops after all three tasks total 100; going offline does not pause it.

rules.zh: 外观：异色5%，连续3轮未出后第4轮保障；提前出异色清零。
rules.en: Appearance: 5% shiny chance; after three misses the fourth is guaranteed, with an early shiny resetting the counter.

rules.zh: 血脉：异色5%、合法奇异血脉20%；资源：异色5%、90,000洛克贝＋6高级球，均不动外观印记。
rules.en: Lineage: 5% shiny and 20% legal rare lineage. Resources: 5% shiny, 90,000 currency and six advanced balls. Neither changes appearance marks.

rules.zh: 确认后锁定一只目标候选；30分钟后转存手册，重入不重抽，捕捉成功才入库。
rules.en: Confirmation locks one target candidate; after 30 minutes it moves to the handbook without rerolling, and only capture adds it to storage.

strength.zh: 调查动作与目标选择进入收集过程，允许用时间换取部分球耗。
strength.en: Investigation actions and target choices shape collection, allowing time to substitute for some ball expenditure.

tradeoff.zh: 新增区域、任务与异常状态；节奏和生态内容质量需要试玩验证。
tradeoff.en: Adds zones, tasks and recovery states. Pacing and ecological content quality still require playtesting.

A.zh: 复用较多 · 成本低—中
固定目标 + 加权普通池

B.zh: 固定目标 + 奖励方向选择
准备、移动与调查可能拖慢节奏
B.en: Preparation, travel and tasks may slow pacing

visible_limit.zh: 推荐来自机制与制作约束的比较。尚无玩家样本，不能把“更主动”写成满意度、留存或收益已经提升。
visible_limit.en: This recommendation compares mechanics and production constraints. With no player sample, more agency cannot be presented as proven gains in satisfaction, retention or revenue.

title.zh: 让规则经得起一次重试。
title.en: Make the rules hold through a retry.

judgment.zh: 结果生成、揭晓与入库是三个状态；重播表现不应重新开奖。
judgment.en: Generating, revealing and collecting an outcome are separate states. Replaying the presentation must not reroll the result.

body.zh: 原型让两案从流程图走到操作：先看目标与进度，再体验破罩、揭晓、捕捉和结算。用重入、切换与重复点击检查规则是否仍然成立。
body.en: The prototype turns both flows into actions: inspect the target and progress, then break the shield, reveal, capture and settle. Re-entry, target changes and repeated clicks expose rule boundaries.

preview_caption.zh: S5 双方案交互原型 · 中文 · 建议桌面或平板横屏体验
preview_caption.en: S5 interactive prototype · Chinese · Best on desktop or landscape tablet

body.zh: 有效捕捉 → 乐章预览 → 破罩 → 分层揭晓 → 捕捉结算。导览预置进度有明确标签。
body.en: Eligible capture → preview → shield break → layered reveal → capture and settlement. Guided progress presets are explicitly labeled.

body.zh: 线索组合 → 三项任务 → 选择奖励方向 → 揭晓与捕捉。自由体验支持六种组合。
body.en: Combine clues → complete three tasks → choose reward focus → reveal and capture. Free exploration supports all six combinations.

body.zh: 切换目标只暂停旧进度，不转移音符、线索或保障。A／B 也不互通。
body.en: Changing target pauses old progress; notes, clues and guarantees do not transfer. A and B are separate.

body.zh: 确认后锁定结果。重入、重播、跳过与捕捉重试不重抽，不重复结算保障。
body.en: Confirmation locks the outcome. Re-entry, replay, skip and capture retries do not reroll or settle guarantees twice.

body.zh: 破罩前显示旧保障与“待揭晓”；揭晓后再同步真实属性与保障变化。
body.en: Before the shield breaks, show the prior guarantee state and “awaiting reveal.” Update attributes and guarantee changes after reveal.

body.zh: 已生成目标异色不等于已获得。缺球、战败或断线后保留同一结果，完成捕捉再入库。
body.en: Generating a target shiny is not owning it. Keep the same result through supply shortages, defeat or disconnect; collection follows a successful capture.

scope.zh: 三击破罩、成败开关、任务热点与固定特长是演示配置。原型不模拟官方捕获率、完整特长分布、真实多人联机或服务器一致性；星夜协奏等扩展保留在方案中。
scope.en: Three-hit shields, success toggles, task hotspots and a fixed specialty are demo settings. The prototype does not simulate official capture rates, full specialty distributions, live multiplayer or server consistency. Extended systems such as the bonus concert remain in the proposal.

fallback.zh: 原型无法打开时，可查看关键操作画面与完整规则。试玩数据只保存在当前浏览器。
fallback.en: If the prototype cannot open, use the keyframes and full rules. Demo progress is stored only in the current browser.

title.zh: 说明完成到哪里，也说明证据到哪里。
title.en: Be clear about both completion and evidence.

judgment.zh: 规则自测可以证明受检分支可运行，不能替代玩家体验与线上验证。
judgment.en: Rule checks can show that tested branches run; they cannot replace player research or live validation.

completed.zh: S3实机流程、11张配置表、特殊情况与位置线框。
completed.en: S3 gameplay flow, 11 configuration tables, special cases and screen wireframes.
